title: Muhammad ﷺ
tagline: The last of the prophets ﷺ, from his childhood in Makkah to the city of Madinah: a mercy to all the worlds.
depictionNotes: Coming soon. The Prophet ﷺ is never shown, at any age: where he is present, the picture leaves him out and a soft breeze passes over it. His family and Companions are shown, every woman's and girl's hair covered.
